channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2026-111793 — Openwave Messaging Limited Webtop Media Transcoder
item.description: Threat Signal 56. Openwave Messaging Limited Webtop Media Transcoder contains an incorrect resource transfer between spheres vulnerability that may allow an authenticated user to process and convert unintended document types if bypassing the Webmail experience.

item.title: CVE-2026-125350 — Google Chromium
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Google Chromium contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XML component that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a specially crafted webpage. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2026-20320 — Cisco BroadWorks
item.description: Threat Signal 62. Cisco BroadWorks contains an improper restriction of XML external entity reference vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to read sensitive configuration information on an affected system.

item.title: CVE-2026-124194 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Microsoft Office Outlook contains a missing user interaction for potentially unsafe action vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.

item.title: CVE-2026-40217 — BerriAI LiteLLM
item.description: Threat Signal 84. BerriAI LiteLLM contains an unprotected alternate channel vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via bytecode rewriting at the /guardrails/test_custom_code URI.

item.title: CVE-2026-72530 — TrueConf Server
item.description: Threat Signal 61. TrueConf Server contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthorized remote attacker with network access via port 4307/TCP to use a specially crafted script to break out of the isolated environment and execute arbitrary code on the host system.

item.title: CVE-2026-72529 — TrueConf Server
item.description: Threat Signal 61. TrueConf Server contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which could allow a remote unauthorized attacker with network access via port 4307/TCP to execute an arbitrary script.

item.title: CVE-2026-18577 — N-able N-central
item.description: Threat Signal 61. N-able N-central contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel allows for authentication bypass and account takeover in N-central. This vulnerability is the result of an incomplete patch for CVE-2026-18556.

item.title: CVE-2026-20262 — Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a directory or path traversal vulnerability that could allow an authenticated, remote attacker to create a file or overwrite any file on the filesystem of an affected system.

item.title: CVE-2026-8398 — Daemon Daemon Tools Lite
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Daemon Tools contains an unspecified vulnerability that has a high impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

item.title: CVE-2025-53521 — F5 BIG-IP
item.description: Threat Signal 61. F5 BIG-IP APM contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability that could allow a threat actor to achieve remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-3910 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Google Chromium V8 contains an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside a sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2023-43000 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Apple macOS, iOS, iPadOS, and Safari 16.6 contain a use-after-free vulnerability due to the processing of maliciously crafted web content that may lead to memory corruption.

item.title: CVE-2018-14634 — Linux Kernel
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Linux Kernel contains an integer overflow vulnerability in the create_elf_tables() function which could allow an unprivileged local user with access to SUID (or otherwise privileged) binary to escalate their privileges on the system.

item.title: CVE-2025-59374 — ASUS Live Update
item.description: Threat Signal 61. ASUS Live Update contains an embedded malicious code vulnerability client were distributed with unauthorized modifications introduced through a supply chain compromise. The modified builds could cause devices meeting specific targeting conditions to perform unintended actions. The impacted product could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

item.title: CVE-2025-42599 — Qualitia Active! Mail
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Qualitia Active! Mail contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary or trigger a denial-of-service via a specially crafted request.

item.title: CVE-2025-24201 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and other Apple products contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in WebKit that may allow maliciously crafted web content to break out of Web Content sandbox. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

item.title: CVE-2024-12686 — BeyondTrust Privileged Remote Access (PRA) and Remote Support (RS)
item.description: Threat Signal 61. BeyondTrust Privileged Remote Access (PRA) and Remote Support (RS) contain an OS command injection vulnerability that can be exploited by an attacker with existing administrative privileges to upload a malicious file. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can allow a remote attacker to execute underlying operating system commands within the context of the site user.

item.title: CVE-2024-35250 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Microsoft Windows Kernel-Mode Driver contains an untrusted pointer dereference vulnerability that allows a local attacker to escalate privileges.

item.title: CVE-2024-49138 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) driver contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows a local attacker to escalate privileges.

item.title: CVE-2019-0344 — SAP Commerce Cloud
item.description: Threat Signal 61. SAP Commerce Cloud (formerly known as Hybris) contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability within the mediaconversion and virtualjdbc extension that allows for code injection.

item.title: CVE-2024-5274 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Google Chromium V8 contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute code via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2024-4671 — Google Chromium
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Google Chromium Visuals contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2023-29360 — Microsoft Streaming Service
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Microsoft Streaming Service contains an untrusted pointer dereference vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation, enabling a local attacker to gain SYSTEM privileges.

item.title: CVE-2024-21351 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Microsoft Windows SmartScreen contains a security feature bypass vulnerability that allows an attacker to bypass the SmartScreen user experience and inject code to potentially gain code execution, which could lead to some data exposure, lack of system availability, or both.

item.title: CVE-2023-35311 — Microsoft Outlook
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Microsoft Outlook contains a security feature bypass vulnerability that allows an attacker to bypass the Microsoft Outlook Security Notice prompt.

item.title: CVE-2023-29492 — Novi Survey Novi Survey
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Novi Survey contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code on the server in the context of the service account.

item.title: CVE-2022-42948 — Fortra Cobalt Strike
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Fortra Cobalt Strike User Interface contains an unspecified vulnerability rooted in Java Swing that may allow remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2022-27518 — Citrix Application Delivery Controller (ADC) and Gateway
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Citrix Application Delivery Controller (ADC) and Gateway, when configured with SAML SP or IdP configuration, contain an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows an attacker to execute code as administrator.

item.title: CVE-2022-41091 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Microsoft Windows Mark of the Web (MOTW) contains a security feature bypass vulnerability resulting in a limited loss of integrity and availability of security features.

item.title: CVE-2019-3010 — Oracle Solaris
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Oracle Solaris component: XScreenSaver contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2015-2360 — Microsoft Win32k
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Win32k.sys in the kernel-mode drivers in Microsoft Windows allows local users to gain privileges or cause denial-of-service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2016-4656 — Apple iOS
item.description: Threat Signal 61. A memory corruption vulnerability in Apple iOS kernel allows attackers to execute code in a privileged context or cause a denial-of-service (DoS) via a crafted application.

item.title: CVE-2016-6367 — Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA)
item.description: Threat Signal 61. A vulnerability in the command-line interface (CLI) parser of Cisco ASA software could allow an authenticated, local attacker to create a denial-of-service (DoS) condition or potentially execute code.

item.title: CVE-2018-5002 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Adobe Flash Player have a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability that could lead to remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-1789 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 61. A type confusion issue affecting multiple Apple products allows processing of maliciously crafted web content, leading to arbitrary code execution.

item.title: CVE-2019-8506 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 61. A type confusion issue affecting multiple Apple products allows processing of maliciously crafted web content, leading to arbitrary code execution.

item.title: CVE-2022-1364 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2016-4523 — Trihedral VTScada (formerly VTS)
item.description: Threat Signal 61. The WAP interface in Trihedral VTScada (formerly VTS) allows remote attackers to cause a denial-of-service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2017-0059 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Microsoft Internet Explorer allow remote attackers to obtain sensitive information from process memory via a crafted web site.

item.title: CVE-2016-0040 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 61. The kernel in Microsoft Windows allows local users to gain privileges via a crafted application.

item.title: CVE-2020-1631 — Juniper Junos OS
item.description: Threat Signal 61. A path traversal vulnerability in the HTTP/HTTPS service used by J-Web, Web Authentication, Dynamic-VPN (DVPN), Firewall Authentication Pass-Through with Web-Redirect, and Zero Touch Provisioning (ZTP) allows an unauthenticated attacker to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2013-5223 — D-Link DSL-2760U
item.description: Threat Signal 61. A cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the D-Link DSL-2760U gateway, allowing remote authenticated users to inject arbitrary web script or HTML.

item.title: CVE-2022-26485 — Mozilla Firefox
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Mozilla Firefox contains a use-after-free vulnerability in XSLT parameter processing which can be exploited to perform arbitrary code execution.

item.title: CVE-2020-8218 — Pulse Secure Pulse Connect Secure
item.description: Threat Signal 61. A code injection vulnerability exists in Pulse Connect Secure that allows an attacker to crafted a URI to perform an arbitrary code execution via the admin web interface.

item.title: CVE-2022-20700 — Cisco Small Business RV160, RV260, RV340, and RV345 Series Routers
item.description: Threat Signal 61. A vulnerability in Cisco Small Business RV160, RV260, RV340, and RV345 Series Routers could allow an attacker to do any of the following: Execute arbitrary code elevate privileges, execute arbitrary commands, bypass authentication and authorization protections, fetch and run unsigned software, or cause a denial of service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2022-22620 — Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS WebKit contain a use-after-free vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

item.title: CVE-2021-22017 — VMware vCenter Server
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Rhttproxy as used in vCenter Server contains a vulnerability due to improper implementation of URI normalization.

item.title: CVE-2021-30858 — Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS WebKit contain a use-after-free vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

item.title: CVE-2021-1871 — Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS
item.description: Threat Signal 61. Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS WebKit contain an unspecified logic vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute code. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.
